AgentSettings.description: Settings for the agent whose `agent_name` is their key in `agents`.

version.description: The `agent_version` the Commission was written for.
version.title: Version

enabled_tools.description:
The built-in tools the run may use, by name. Covers only tools without an
`mcp_server_id`.
enabled_tools.title: Enabled Tools

enabled_subagents.description: The built-in subagents the run may use, by name.
enabled_subagents.title: Enabled Subagents

enabled_skills.description: The built-in skills the run may use, by name.
enabled_skills.title: Enabled Skills

enabled_mcp_servers.description: The built-in MCP servers the run may use, by `id`.
enabled_mcp_servers.title: Enabled Mcp Servers

AgentSettings.title: AgentSettings

EnvSecret.description: A secret in a variable of the agent's environment.

env.description:
The name of a variable in the agent's environment that holds the secret,
for example `"TEST_DB_PASSWORD"`.
env.title: Env

EnvSecret.title: EnvSecret

McpServerHttp.description: An MCP server the agent connects to over Streamable HTTP.

name.description: A display name, when it differs from `id`.
name.title: Name

headers.description:
HTTP headers to send with each request. A Secret reference's secret is
the header's entire value.
headers.title: Headers

McpServerHttp.title: McpServerHttp

McpServerStdio.description: An MCP server the agent starts as a local program and talks to over stdio.

name.description: A display name, when it differs from `id`.
name.title: Name

command.description: The program and its arguments, for example `["npx", "-y", "@example/db-mcp"]`.
command.title: Command

env.description:
Environment variables to set for the program, on top of those the
agent's MCP client gives it.
env.title: Env

McpServerStdio.title: McpServerStdio

Model.description: A model as one service offers it, named with models.dev provider and model IDs.

provider.description:
The service that runs the model, for example `"anthropic"`,
`"amazon-bedrock"`, or `"openrouter"`. It decides which API the agent calls
and how it authenticates.
provider.title: Provider

id.description:
The model's ID at that service, as the agent sends it, for example
`"claude-sonnet-4-6"`.
id.title: Id

base_url.description: The URL of the service's API. Absent means the service's default.
base_url.title: Base Url

credential.description:
The API key for the service. Absent means the agent uses whatever
credential its environment has for the service. A `proxy` credential is the
key alone; the proxy adds it as `provider`'s API expects.
credential.title: Credential

Model.title: Model

ProxySecret.description: A secret that a proxy outside the agent holds and adds to its requests.

proxy.description:
The name of a credential that a proxy outside the agent holds. The proxy
adds it to the agent's matching requests, so the agent never receives its
value.
proxy.title: Proxy

ProxySecret.title: ProxySecret

Skill.description: A skill directory, as defined by Agent Skills, carried in the Commission.

name.description: The skill's name. Equals the `name` in the frontmatter of its `SKILL.md`.
name.title: Name

files.description:
The skill's files: each key is a path relative to the skill directory,
and each value is the file's UTF-8 content. Includes `"SKILL.md"`.
files.title: Files

Skill.title: Skill

Supervisor.description: The supervisor that wrote the Commission.
Supervisor.title: Supervisor

description: The message a supervisor sends once to start an agent run. See commission.md.

avp_version.description: The AVP version the Commission follows.
avp_version.title: Avp Version

run_id.description: The run's ID, chosen by the supervisor.
run_id.title: Run Id

model.description: The model to run, and the service that runs it.

system_prompt.description: The system prompt for the run. It replaces the agent's own.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

prompt.description: The first user message of the run.
prompt.title: Prompt

supervisor.description: The supervisor that wrote the Commission.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers to add for the run.
mcp_servers.title: Mcp Servers

skills.description: Skills to add for the run.
skills.title: Skills

agents.description: Settings for specific agents, keyed by `agent_name`.
agents.title: Agents

output_schema.description: A JSON Schema for the agent's final output. Its `type` is `"object"`.
output_schema.title: Output Schema

thread_id.description: An ID that groups related runs, such as the turns of one conversation.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

meta.description: Key-value data for the supervisor's own use.
meta.title: Meta

title: AVP v0.1 Commission
